ngos.name: Pratham Education Foundation
ngos.tagline: Every Child in School and Learning Well
ngos.description: Pratham is one of the largest non-governmental organizations in India, working to provide quality education to underprivileged children. leadership.founderBio: Founded by Rippan Kapur in 1979 with a mission to ensure child rights are fulfilled across India.

operations.beneficiaries: Children below 18 years from marginalized communities

ngos.name: Goonj
ngos.tagline: Turning Urban Surplus into Rural Resource
ngos.description: Goonj is a New Delhi-based NGO that works on urban-to-rural resource distribution. Founded by Anshu Gupta in 1999, Goonj has pioneered the concept of Cloth as a basic need.

Cloth for Work program in 150+ districts

ngos.name: Akshaya Patra Foundation
